name: Karrinyup Shopping Centre
profile_status: Partial: bounded public research complete; commercial and coverage gaps explicit
decision_use: Use as a large, established multi-anchor destination with substantial observed optical competition. Resident-area income and demographics help frame questions but do not describe the full customer catchment.
remaining_questions: Which available frontage or entry route has relevant pedestrian exposure relative to the existing optical stores? | Can the owner supply current footfall, customer origins and an occupied-tenancy schedule?

name: Ed.Square Town Centre
profile_status: Partial: public research pass completed 10 October 2026; unresolved items explicitly recorded
decision_use: Compare candidate frontages against station routes, supermarket access and the two accepted optical businesses. Public evidence now establishes destination format and scale, but does not establish achievable sales, rents or unmet optical demand.
remaining_questions: Obtain the current leasing plan with available unit areas and pedestrian routes. | Confirm post-acquisition holding entities and the permanent leasing contact or agency mandate. | Request dated footfall and customer-origin evidence plus the trade-area boundary. | Reconcile marketing GLA against the latest tenancy schedule and asset-area definition.

name: Jetty Road
profile_status: Partial: bounded public research complete; commercial and coverage gaps explicit
decision_use: Compare specific street segments and post-works pedestrian movement. Older resident-area demographics and a coastal visitor offer warrant separate resident/visitor questions; neither establishes customer mix.
remaining_questions: Which street segment and frontage benefits from pedestrian routes after the works? | What evidence separates year-round resident demand from visitor seasonality? | Do the remaining address/identity conflicts matter to a specific candidate unit?
